channel.title: RideMeme Digest — Philippine & world motoring
channel.description: The day's top Philippine and world motoring stories, auto-curated.

item.title: ACMobility rolls out EV safety education nationwide
item.description: ACMobility has launched a nationwide electric vehicle education program aimed at giving Filipino drivers practical information on EV safety, charging, ownership costs and emergency procedures. item.title: Xpeng Philippines has begun pre-sales of the X9
item.description: The brand is taking a limited number of reservations for its flagship MPV

item.title: Kia PH partnering with Philippine Tennis Academy to support young talents
item.description: The Korean brand is committing P1-M annually to support funding

item.title: JLR opens electric Range Rover orders
item.description: Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) has opened orders for its first fully electric Range Rover, a key launch for the British luxury carmaker as it recovers from a cyberattack that stopped production for more than a month last year.

item.title: Aero upgrade: Suzuki introduces sportier Ertiga hybrid model
item.description: Suzuki Philippines has introduced the Ertiga GLX Hybrid Sport to the local market with a retail price of P1,199,000. The vehicle targets buyers who need three rows of seating but want a more aggressive vehicle profile than typical family haulers.

item.title: Lynk & Co expands dealership ahead of 900 debut
item.description: Lynk & Co has partnered with new authorized dealer groups to broaden vehicle distribution and maintenance support nationwide. Executives finalized the dealership contracts during an official signing ceremony in Hangzhou, China.

item.title: Bermaz Auto assumes operations at Mazda C5 Pasig
item.description: Bermaz Auto Asia has taken charge of daily retail operations at Mazda C5 Pasig. The business transition took effect on 1 August 2026, following the end of an earlier management contract with Inchcape Philippines on 31 July.

item.title: iCaur enters Phl market with two SUVs
item.description: Omoda and Jaecoo Philippines has confirmed the local launch of iCaur this October 2026. The young marque started business in China back in 2023 under the original nameplate iCar.

item.title: GAC AION V completes inter-island BEV road tests
item.description: Two Filipino motorists have completed cross-country journeys behind the wheel of the GAC AION V, testing the viability of battery electric vehicles (BEV) across highways and island sea links.

item.title: The British Army's Great Panjandrum Was The Most Bonkers Vehicle Ever Dreamed Up
item.description: A "panjandrum" is a self-important person, but Britain's Great Panjandrum was an absurd military vehicle powered by an even crazier means of motion.

item.title: Raindrops Can Cause 9,000-Volt Zaps That Eat Through Your Car's Paint
item.description: Using atomic force microscopy, researchers found defects on the surface that had eaten through both the Teflon film and the copper.

item.title: Chinese Brands Got So Fast At Developing New Cars Even China Thinks They Should Slow Down
item.description: AI could cut new-car development to mere months, but regulators fear quality and safety might pay the price
